rules.statement: An action for partition is not necessarily an action to which section 547 applies, and the true position would seem to be that such an action is not necessarily an action for the 'recovery of property'.
rules.supporting_quote: "So that when objections under that section is taken, the question to be decided is whether the real or substantial purpose of the action is to determine questions of title. If such be the case, the proper course, as approved by this Court in Hassen Hadjiar v. Marikcar 1 and Gooneratne v. Hamine 3 , is to afford to the plaintiffs an opportunity of obtaining administration."
